The board will review the full tax classification package on the 18th and add it to that meeting's agenda.

The presenter corrected where the budget was calculated in the tax classification presentation and fixed an error.

why_it_matters: The tax classification hearing decides whether residential and commercial property are taxed at a single rate or a split rate, which affects how the tax levy is divided between homeowners and businesses on a resident's bill.
Decisions on senior and veterans exemptions reduce the tax bills of the applicants who qualify; the minutes caption no outcome for those applications.
